package amba_axi4_single_interface_requirements
property exit_from_reset(aresetn, valid): !aresetn || $rose(aresetn) |-> !valid
property stable_before_handshake(valid, ready, control): valid && !ready |-> ##1 $stable(control)
property valid_before_handshake(valid, ready): valid && !ready |-> ##1 valid
property valid_before_ready(valid, ready): valid && !ready
property ready_before_valid(valid, ready): ready && !valid
property valid_with_ready(valid, ready): valid && ready
property handshake_max_wait(valid, ready, timeout): valid & !ready |-> ##[1:timeout] ready
property handshake_max_wait_R(valid, ready, timeout): valid & !ready |-> ##[1:timeout] !valid || ready
property valid_information(valid, sig): valid |-> !$isunknown(sig)
property start_address_align(valid, burst, address, size): valid && burst == amba_axi4_protocol_checker_pkg::WRAP |-> addr_align_check(address, size)
property full_data_transaction(valid, default_strb_value): valid |-> default_strb_value
property rdwr_response_okay(valid, ready, resp): valid && ready && resp == amba_axi4_protocol_checker_pkg::OKAY
property rdwr_response_exokay(valid, ready, resp): valid && ready && resp == amba_axi4_protocol_checker_pkg::EXOKAY
property rdwr_response_slverr(valid, ready, resp): valid && ready && resp == amba_axi4_protocol_checker_pkg::SLVERR
property rdwr_response_decerr(valid, ready, resp): valid && ready && resp == amba_axi4_protocol_checker_pkg::DECERR
property axi4_back_to_back(valid, ready): valid && ready ##1 valid
property axi4_wait_state(valid, ready): valid && !ready ##1 ready
property axi4_no_wait_state(valid, ready): !valid || ready ##1 valid && ready
module yosyshq_axi4_lite_monitor ports ACLK:1 ARESETn:1 AWVALID:1 AWREADY:1 WVALID:1 WREADY:1 BVALID:1 BREADY:1 ARVALID:1 ARREADY:1 RVALID:1 RREADY:1 AWADDR:8 ARADDR:8 AWPROT:3 ARPROT:3 WDATA:32 RDATA:32 WSTRB:4 BRESP:2 RRESP:2 params MAXWAIT=16
assert ap_AW_EXIT_RESET in yosyshq_axi4_lite_monitor, line 18
  clock     @(posedge ACLK)
  property  exit_from_reset
  expr      exit_from_reset(ARESETn, AWVALID)
  s1        !ARESETn || $rose(ARESETn)
  s2        !AWVALID
  signals   ACLK:1 ARESETn:1 AWVALID:1
  message   error "Violation: AWVALID must be low in reset (A3.1.2)"

assert ap_AW_STABLE_AWADDR in yosyshq_axi4_lite_monitor, line 25
  clock     @(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn)
  property  stable_before_handshake
  expr      stable_before_handshake(AWVALID, AWREADY, AWADDR)
